name: Sea temperature and waves
summary: Modelled sea surface temperature and wave height at points around the coast of Cyprus, from the Open-Meteo marine service.

el.name: Θερμοκρασία θάλασσας και κύματα
el.summary: Θερμοκρασία επιφάνειας θάλασσας και ύψος κύματος από μοντέλο σε σημεία γύρω από τις ακτές της Κύπρου, από την υπηρεσία θάλασσας της Open-Meteo.

restrictions: Free API is for non-commercial use only

quality.uncertainty: Open-sea model values. A harbour or a beach can differ a lot.

use_for: Sea conditions for the coastal cities

notes: Open-Meteo's sea temperature comes from the Copernicus Marine global ocean model (about 8 km, 6-hourly, refreshed daily), which assimilates satellite sea temperature. So it is not independent of the satellite layer noaa-sst.
